Advocate, UPPCL ORDER This petition has been filed by the P etitioner, NTPC Limited (in short, ‘NTPC’), for approval of the tariff of Singrauli Super Thermal Power Station (2000 MW) (in short, ‘the generating station’) for the period 2024-29, in accordance with the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 (in short ‘, the 2024 Tariff Regulations’). 2. The generating station has a total capacity of 2000 MW, comprising five units of 200 MW each and two units of 500 MW each. The dates of commissioning of the various units and that of the generating station are as under: Unit CoD Unit – I 1.6.1982 Unit – II 1.2.1983 Unit – III 1.7.1983 Unit – IV 1.1.1984 Unit – V 1.6.1984 Unit – VI 1.7.1987 Unit – VII/ Generating Station 1.5.1988 3. The Commission, vide its order dated 16.8.2026 in Petition No. 648/GT/2025, had revised the tariff of the generating station for the period 2019-24 after a truing-up Order in Petition No. 647/GT/2025 Page 2 of 57 since ash transportation charges are recurring in nature and the Petitioner has been incurring the same at the generating station in the current tariff period also, grave prejudice would be caused to the beneficiaries in case the Commission does not permit/allow the Petitioner to recover fly ash transportation charges on the issuance of this tariff order, because in that case the beneficiaries would be foisted with additional liability of interest payment. The Petitioner has thus prayed to allow the recovery of ash transportation charges on a monthly basis, subject to truing up at the end of the 2024-29 period. 88. The Petitioner has also submitted that it has filed Petition No. 227/MP/2024 seeking recovery of fly ash transportation charges, which, as on date, is pending disposal before the Commission. Reliance has also been placed by the Petitioner on the order of the Commission dated 28.10.2022 in Petition No. 205/MP/2021 wherein the Commission has considered the difficulties being faced by the Petitioner and allowed the billing and recovery of the said expenses on a monthly basis for the period 2019-24. 89. The Respondents, TPDPL, BRPL, and BYPL, vide their respective replies, have submitted that the Petitioner’s claim for recovery of ash transportation charges through monthly billing is premature and contrary to the framework under the 2024 Tariff Regulations, which specifically requires that such claims be examined under Regulation 36(1)(6) on the basis of a detailed prudence check. The earlier Order dated 28.10.2022 in Petition No. 205/MP/2021, relied upon by the Petitioner, is distinguishable, and the issue is already sub judice in Petition No. 227/MP/2024. Further, the Petitioner failed to disclose essential plant-wise data and revenue earned from sale of fly ash; any recovery of gross transportation costs without adjusting corresponding revenue would result in unjust enrichment. Order in Petition No. 647/GT/2025 Page 43 of 57 reimbursement of the filing fees and publication expenses in connection with the present Petition, directly from the beneficiaries on a pro-rata basis in accordance with Regulation 94(2) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. 125. Similarly, RLDC Fees & Charges paid by the Petitioner under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Fees and Charges of Regional Load Dispatch Centre and other related matters) Regulations, 2009, shall be recovered from the beneficiaries. In addition, the Petitioner is entitled to recovery of statutory taxes, levies, duties, cess etc., levied by the statutory authorities in accordance with the 2024 Tariff Regulations. Summary 126. Accordingly, the annual fixed charges claimed and allowed for the period 2024- 29 are summarised as under: (Rs. In lakh) 2024-25 2025-26 2026-27 2027-28 2028-29 Annual fixed charges claimed 189820.86 175882.30 182403.40 161532.76 164985.60 Annual Fixed Charges allowed 109656.72 113838.46 117469.98 121518.11 125762.17 127. In addition, the Petitioner shall recover the water charges, security expenses and ash transportation expenses in terms of the notification dated 20.3.2026 as discussed in paras 122 and 123 above. Further, the annual fixed charges approved as above, are subject to truing up in terms of Regulation 13 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. 128. Petition No. 647/GT/2025 is disposed of accordingly.
